messages.author: 942ffec526d6a312
messages.subject: Re: the legend's symbols are overlapped together
parts:
Hi Tian,

I recreate your problem with a little bit of made-up data:

x1 <- 1:20
y1 <- x1+0.5
x2 <- x1+rnorm(20,sd=0.01)
y2 <- 2*x2+0.5

d <- data.frame(x1,y1,x2,y2)
ggplot(data=d)+geom_point(aes(x=x1,y=y1,colour="red"),pch=0)+geom_point(aes(x=x2,y=y2,colour="blue"),pch=1)

What you need is to have the colour and shape mapped to a variable
identifying the pair of columns that it came from (point1, point2...
in your email). So if you set up your data along these lines
(that is, "long" rather than "wide" - package reshape2 can probably
help here if you have a lot of columns to deal with):

dd<-data.frame(x=c(x1,x2),y=c(y1,y2),f=rep(c("p1","p2"),each=20))

and map colour and shape to f within an aes when plotting, then

ggplot(dd,aes(x=x,y=y))+geom_point(aes(colour=f,shape=f))

should get you started.

Ron.

Tian, 

Your data may have a lot of rows, but it is technically "wide". I've tried sporadically since you posted this to get it wide with tidyr, but can't seem to. I found this stackoverflow answer that seems to work on the dataset that Ron created using base-r reshape(). 

https://stackoverflow.com/questions/15931543/how-to-organize-and-plot-multiple-series-of-data-out-of-one-data-frame-using-ggp

library(tidyr)

x1 <- 1:20
y1 <- x1+0.5
x2 <- x1+rnorm(20,sd=0.01)
y2 <- 2*x2+0.5

d <- data.frame(x1,y1,x2,y2)

dat.reshape <- reshape(d, direction="long",  varying=list(c(1, 3), c(2, 4)), sep="", v.names=c("x", "y"))

HTH,

B

I have solved this problem. The codes are as follows. 

mydata_long= reshape(mydata, direction="long",
                     varying=list(c(1,3,5,7),c(2,4,6,8)), 
                     sep=" ", v.names=c("q", "I"))
p=ggplot(data=mydata_long,aes(x=q,y=I))
p+geom_point(aes(col=factor(time),shape=factor(time)),size=4)+
  scale_color_discrete(name  ="",breaks=c(1,2,3,4),labels=mysamples)+
  scale_shape_discrete(name  ="",labels=mysamples,solid=F)

Thank you for Ron Crump and Brandon Hurr's kind help!
